word: Vendors protect their fruit from the sun.
answer: Los vendedores protegen su fruta del sol.

word: We respond when someone asks for prices.
answer: Respondemos cuando alguien pregunta los precios.

word: I go back to the first stand to compare.
answer: Retrocedo al primer puesto para comparar.

word: They break open a coconut to show the inside.
answer: Ellos rompen un coco para mostrar el interior.

word: You surprise me with a fresh drink.
answer: Me sorprendes con una bebida fresca.

word: Many things happen at the market every day.
answer: Muchas cosas suceden en el mercado cada día.

word: She suspends her shopping to take a call.
answer: Ella suspende sus compras para tomar una llamada.

word: He fears losing his wallet in the crowd.
answer: Él teme perder su cartera entre la gente.

word: I cough a little from the smoke of a grill.
answer: Toso un poco por el humo de una parrilla.

word: Tomorrow they are going to sell new handmade baskets.
answer: Mañana van a vender canastas hechas a mano.
